title: Viktor Oddy — Independent Design Studio
features: Narrow editorial introduction, infinite project ribbon, parallax portrait, both $5,000 offers, five-testimonial auto-carousel with hover pause and controls, three project showcases, pointer-art trail, footer anchors and fixed chat dock.
limitations: React/Vite/TypeScript/Tailwind and hooks are adapted to native browser modules. Referenced GIFs and photos are replaced with original graphic studies and an illustrated portrait. Testimonials and project claims are source-specified demonstration content, not independently verified endorsements. Chat links go to the requested external booking URL; no booking backend.
